name: carhauler247-car-shipping-quotes
description: Real car shipping and auto transport quotes between any two places in the 48 continental US states, from CarHauler247, a licensed broker. Book online.

interface.longDescription:
Ask how much it costs to ship your car and get a real auto transport quote for your exact route. Not a range, and nobody will call you.

CarHauler247 is a licensed auto transport broker (USDOT 3486358, MC 1149762). This app gives you the same prices as carhauler247.com. Tell ChatGPT where the vehicle is, where it's going and what it is.

What you get:
- Two prices, you choose: the Industry Standard market-based starting price, and, when we can guarantee it, the Price & Dates Lock price, where the price and pickup window are locked when you book.
- Dates: the guaranteed pickup window and estimated delivery dates. Need it sooner? Faster guaranteed pickup within 4 or 2 business days, each with its own price.
- Deadlines: tell ChatGPT when the car must be picked up or delivered by, or when you'll be there to receive it - each guaranteed window is timed to fit, and any that can't make it are marked.
- Moving or buying a car out of state: get the shipping cost alongside your move or purchase.
- Any vehicle: cars, SUVs, pickup trucks, vans and minivans - if your model's versions ship at different prices (like a crew or regular cab), it asks which one you have; open or enclosed; running or not; up to 10 vehicles on one route.
- What moves the price, and what each plan guarantees, when you ask.
- One-click booking: each price links to carhauler247.com with your route, vehicle and date already filled in.

Covers all 48 continental US states. No account needed to get a quote.
capabilities: Open or enclosed, running or not
defaultPrompt: How much to ship my 2019 Toyota RAV4 from 94609 to 30144?
Auto transport quote for my car from San Jose, CA to Austin, TX next month
Cost to ship a 2017 Tundra regular cab from Manchester, TN to 28651

positive.description: Basic quote with ZIP codes and a specific vehicle - the Industry Standard starting price and the Price & Dates Lock price.
positive.prompt: How much to ship my 2019 Toyota RAV4 from 94609 to 30144?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Industry Standard starting price marked 'Market-based starting price - may change' and the guaranteed price marked 'Price & Dates Lock included', each with its booking link, for a 2019 Toyota RAV4 from Oakland, CA 94609 to Kennesaw, GA 30144, about 2,480 miles with the driving time. Booking links go to carhauler247.com/quote pre-filled with the route, vehicle and date.

positive.description: City and state instead of ZIP codes, with a relative date - a relocation.
positive.prompt: I'm moving from San Jose, CA to Austin, TX next month. What does it cost to ship my 2020 Honda Civic?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves both cities to ZIP codes, passes a ship_date about a month out, and returns a price (marked 'Price & Dates Lock included' when the lock is available), the distance and driving time, and a pre-filled booking link.

positive.description: Enclosed transport - Price & Dates Lock isn't available, so a starting price with the reason.
positive.prompt: Get me a quote for enclosed transport of a 2022 Chevrolet Corvette from Los Angeles, CA to Miami, FL.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with enclosed=true and returns a starting price clearly marked as not guaranteed, with the reason 'Not available for enclosed transport', plus distance, driving time and a booking link.

positive.description: Non-running vehicle - starting price with the reason.
positive.prompt: My 2015 Ford F-150 doesn't run. How much to ship it from Denver, CO to Dallas, TX?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with vehicle_type pickup and inoperable=true and returns a starting price marked as not guaranteed, with the reason 'Not available for non-operational vehicles', plus a booking link.

positive.description: Two different vehicles on one route - one call, one total.
positive.prompt: I need to ship two cars from 13501 to 33813: a 2008 Lexus GS 350 and a 2003 Honda Accord. How much for both?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool once with both vehicles in vehicle_list and returns one total price for both (with the multi-vehicle discount), distance from Utica, NY to Lakeland, FL, driving time and one booking link with both vehicles pre-filled.

positive.description: Follow-up question about what affects the price - answered from price_factors.
positive.prompt: How much to ship my 2019 Toyota 4Runner from Austin, TX to Sparks, NV? Why is it that much?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the price with distance, driving time and a booking link, and explains the main factors from price_factors in dollars (for example truck capacity at the locations or the vehicle's size), without mentioning any service fee.

positive.description: A deadline - faster guaranteed pickup windows with their dates.
positive.prompt: I need my 2019 Toyota RAV4 shipped from Oakland, CA 94609 to Kennesaw, GA 30144, picked up by the end of next week. What are my options?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Price & Dates Lock price with its 8-business-day pickup window and estimated delivery dates, and the faster guaranteed pickup options (within 4 and 2 business days) with their prices, pickup windows, estimated delivery dates and booking links, pointing out which options meet the date. Delivery dates are presented as estimates.

positive.description: A delivery deadline - each guaranteed pickup window timed to deliver by the date, with any that can't make it marked late.
positive.prompt: I need my 2019 Toyota RAV4 delivered from Oakland, CA 94609 to Kennesaw, GA 30144 by the end of this month. What are my options?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with deliver_by set to the last day of the month and returns the Price & Dates Lock options (8, 4 and 2 business-day pickup windows), each starting as late as it can and still deliver by that date, with its price, pickup window, estimated delivery dates and booking link. Any window that can't make the date even starting as early as possible is shown as may be late, never as fitting. Delivery dates are presented as estimates.

positive.description: A model whose versions ship at different prices - the quote first, then one question.
positive.prompt: How much to ship my 2018 Ford F-150 from Phoenix, AZ to Denver, CO?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the price, distance, driving time and booking link, then asks the one question from price_depends_on (for example the cab type), and quotes again with the answer added to the model.

negative.description: Alaska needs marine transport, which CarHauler247 doesn't arrange - the app should give no price and explain, offering to truck the car to the departure port instead.
negative.prompt: How much to ship my car from Seattle to Anchorage, Alaska?

negative.description: Motorcycles aren't a supported vehicle type (cars, SUVs, pickups, vans and minivans only) - the app should decline to price it.
negative.prompt: What does it cost to ship my Harley-Davidson motorcycle from Austin to Denver?

negative.description: The app can't book or take payment in ChatGPT - it only returns a price and a link; booking and payment happen on carhauler247.com.
negative.prompt: Book my car shipment from Miami to Atlanta for tomorrow and charge my credit card ending in 4242.

publication.release_notes: Deadlines: tell ChatGPT when the vehicle must be picked up or delivered by, or the first day you can receive it, and each guaranteed pickup window is timed to fit, with any that can't make it marked. For models whose versions ship at different prices, it asks one quick question (like the cab type) and updates the quote.
